'''Ebon Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Mini" /> Flown by [[TIE pilot|pilots]] trained to use group strategies and tactics, the squadron's TIEs had improved targeting systems at the expense of maneuverability and defensive capabilities&mdash;which were among the poorest in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ebon Squadron was represented by a miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set#Imperial Power-up Pack|''Imperial Power-up Pack'']] supplement to the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' in [[June]] [[2007]].<ref name="Mini" />
